mapper.select: SELECT doc_id, pet_id, reg_number FROM pet_registration WHERE reg_number = #{regNumber} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM pet_registration WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_registration (doc_id, pet_id, reg_number, name, breed, gender, neutered, birth_date, rfid_cd, rfid_gubun, org_nm, office_tel, apr_gbn_nm, reg_tm, apr_tm, last_synced_at) VALUES (#{docId}, #{petId}, #{regNumber}, #{name}, #{breed}, #{gender}, #{neutered}, #{birthDate}, #{rfidCd}, #{rfidGubun}, #{orgNm}, #{officeTel}, #{aprGbnNm}, #{regTm}, #{aprTm}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_registration SET reg_number = #{regNumber}, name = #{name}, breed = #{breed}, gender = #{gender}, neutered = #{neutered}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, rfid_cd = #{rfidCd}, rfid_gubun = #{rfidGubun}, org_nm = #{orgNm}, office_tel = #{officeTel}, apr_gbn_nm = #{aprGbnNm}, reg_tm = #{regTm}, apr_tm = #{aprTm}, last_synced_at = NOW() WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND pet_id = #{petId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pet_registration WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND doc_id = #{docId}
